selection: GWOSC cumulative GWTC list, events with parameter estimates (luminosity_distance not null)
distance: dist_pc = Planck18 comoving distance of the GWOSC median luminosity distance: z from inverting d_L(z) = (1+z) d_C(z) on the coords.py Planck18 grid, then d_C = d_L/(1+z). The 3D volumes use the same conversion per radial bin edge. GWOSC 'redshift' (LVK, Planck15) is kept as a fact.

facts_keys.type: from median source masses, 3 Msun neutron-star limit (display classification)
facts_keys.position: 'uncertain' for every event except GW170817 ('host galaxy')
facts_keys.vol90_mpc3: 90 % credible comoving volume (Planck18), from the sky map, Mpc^3
facts_keys.area90_deg2: 90 % credible sky area from the sky map
facts_keys.comoving_dist_mpc: Planck18 conversion of lum_dist_mpc (bounds converted too)

loc_format: loc.e = list of ellipsoids [w, cx, cy, cz, a, b, c, qx, qy, qz, qw]: weight, centre (Galactic, comoving pc), semi-axes (pc) at the 90 % radius of a 3D Gaussian (2.5003 sigma), quaternion from ellipsoid axes to Galactic

check_vs_ligo_skymap_stats.note: LVK numbers use Planck15 and the native multi-order resolution; ours Planck18

citations.ref: GWOSC event portal, cumulative GWTC list (LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA; Abbott et al. 2023, ApJS 267, 29 'Open Data from LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA through the First Part of the Fourth Observing Run'), CC BY 4.0
